_conditions_doc: What the ratios below were measured under. Only the workloads listed in _reseeded_doc were refreshed under these conditions; the rest predate them and carry no absolutes, so the gate reports a fall on them as unattributed.
_doc: Committed measured best ratios (python_time/go_time) at reference_scale, from the bench/top30 --python run after close-remaining-python-perf-gaps (O(1) metadata ops, parallel window grouping, parallel rank, byte-appending parallel CSV writer). Refresh from the same run as top30_summary.json.
_reseeded_doc: Refreshed from the run of 2026-08-31 (run_top30_benchmark.sh --light --benchtime 1s, Go 1.27.0, polars 1.27.1, M4 Pro / 12 cores), same run as the committed top30_summary.json: DataFrame/fill_null, DataFrame/select, DataFrame/sort, Expr/fill_null, Expr/rank, Expr/rolling_mean, Expr/rolling_sum. absolutes records the two times each refreshed ratio was computed from, so a later fall can be attributed to a side instead of guessed at. A workload absent from absolutes has an older ratio whose absolute times were never recorded.
